references.text: The same ritual of slaughtering a bird over an earthenware vessel with running water is repeated for the cleansing of a house with leprosy
The live bird is dipped in the blood from the slaughtered bird mixed with the running water, and used to sprinkle on the one being cleansed
Slaughtering a sacrificial animal as part of the cleansing ritual, performed in the presence of the priest
Running water (מַיִם חַיִּים) is also used in the cleansing ritual with the red heifer
Running water is used for cleansing from discharge
The Old Testament cleansing ritual involving blood points forward to Christ's blood that cleanses the conscience
